codeReview.summary: The fix resolves three of the four round-1 blockers: the forbidden migration DDL literal is gone from Go files, the duplicate project-by-id SELECTs were centralized behind GetProjectByID and backed by a LOWER(domain) expression index, and the missing GET-only method guards plus /readyz healthy-path actor checks are now covered. The remaining blocker is the repository-test portion: the new repository_test.go adds scan/helper assertions, but it still does not exercise the required repository operations (CreateUser/FindUserByEmail, CreateProject/UpdateProject/DeleteProject, ClaimBuildJob, ClaimDeployment, CreateOperation) that caused bh-core-tests to fail in round 1.

issues.description: This fix still does not add repository-level coverage for the CRUD/claim operations called out in the original failure. The new tests in repository_test.go are limited to scan helpers, interface compliance, column-count checks, and helper functions (see tests starting at lines 37, 70, 110, 156, 200, 227, 266, 288, 309, 329, and 356). A grep across *_test.go still finds no direct coverage for CreateUser/FindUserByEmail, CreateProject/UpdateProject/DeleteProject, ClaimBuildJob, ClaimDeployment, or CreateOperation, whose implementations remain in auth.go:22,32; projects.go:55,101,154; runner_execution.go:43,229; and operations.go:53. That means the round-1 bh-core-tests blocker is not actually resolved.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared state still lacks guidance for how this repo expects database-backed repository methods to be tested. The worker spent time discovering there was no sqlite/sqlmock fixture and then substituted scan/helper tests, which left the blocking repository-coverage requirement unresolved.
